title: Amazon launches new Android tablets with Alexa+ AI
key_facts: Amazon introduced three Android tablets with its Alexa+ AI assistant and Google Play Store access: Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, Tablet 11 and Tablet 8, plus Kids tablets.
Prices: Tablet 12 Pro from $499.99 (Nanomatte version $549.99), Tablet 11 $329.99, Tablet 8 from $229.99.
Alexa+ offers voice help and optional on-screen intelligence, which is off by default.
Alexa+ requires an Amazon Prime membership or a separate subscription.
Removing lock-screen ads costs a one-time $20 on eligible models; the top-priced tablet comes without these ads.
Shipping starts 14 Oct in the US, Mexico and Canada, and 19 Oct in the UK, Germany, France, Italy and Spain; Japan gets the Kids tablets from 14 Oct.
Amazon has not announced an India launch.
quote_evidence: Amazon has introduced a new range of tablets that combines its Alexa+ AI assistant with Android software, access to the Google Play Store, and upgraded hardware.
Alexa+ also requires an Amazon Prime membership or a separate subscription.
why_it_matters_hint: Amazon's tablets move from its own app store to Android and put its paid AI assistant at the centre, with ads on cheaper models.
event_date: Announcement date not stated in the article (published 9 Oct 2026; ships from 14 Oct).
notes: Read Business Today in full. Specs and prices are Amazon's, relayed by the outlet.
